newsitem.title: USA: Mass. to pay off Middlesex debt today - report.
newsitem.headline: Mass. to pay off Middlesex debt today - report.

text.p: The Massachusetts Office of Administration and Finance will pay $11.9 billion in overdue bonds and other debts due today, the Boston Herald reported Thursday.

Mass. Governor William Weld signed legislation last week eliminating Middlesex County, which defaulted on a bond payment earlier this year. The state Senate has estimated it would cost about $25 million to cover Middlesex County debts, but Leslie Kirwan, the head of the state Office of Administration and Finance, told the Herald the actual cost will likely be lower.
